claims.text: The frozen extraction preserves the source distinctions and text-presence counts needed for these candidate decisions: for the six Stage 4.4 candidate forms (soreyi, asoreyi, xolkete, pxolkete, xolkte, wisi), the frozen extraction's text-presence counts on the held-out partition equal the counts the registered witness protocol (spec section 3) derives from the acquired build's source witnesses at every decision-bearing locus, and no adjudicated correction changes either leg of any form's frozen prediction (presence in at least 3 held-out texts; held-out funerary share within [0.75, 1.0]). This does not establish: that the acquired build's transcriptions are true to Griffith's printed editions (not machine-readable here; corpus completion record section 4, gap 5), or that any candidate reading is correct.

evidence.description: The Co-scientist Round D assessment (unit D-M-3) and the sweep adjudication of 2026-11-23 (PR #725), which carried the proposal as owner decision OD-D-2; the Stage 4.4 outcome record of 2026-11-20 (five of six candidates UNSUPPORTED on held-out, four of them sparse against the 3-text bar); the acquired build's own reported 95.6 percent transcription accuracy (corpus completion record section 2), an aggregate figure that is not a candidate-specific error estimate.

falsification_tests: A demonstrated source/extraction discrepancy that crosses a registered decision boundary kills the claim for the affected candidate; if adjudicated source corrections leave every relevant threshold outcome unchanged, the input-error explanation of the failures is retired within the checked scope; if witnesses or search coverage are insufficient, the outcome for the affected candidate is NOT CHECKED / INCOMPLETE COVERAGE, not verified absence.

claims.text: The split membership is fixed throughout the diagnostic: the execution recomputes the basis and partition from the pinned build by freeze v2 section 1's rule and verifies the frozen counts; every witness correction is applied to token counts within that frozen partition, and no corrected text is rehashed and no text changes side. This does not establish: that the frozen split was well chosen; only that this diagnostic holds it fixed, so its result answers the extraction question and not a re-split question.

evidence.description: Campaign freeze v2 of Spec 097, sections 1 and 2 (the split rule and its counts: 368 distinct texts, 335 development / 33 held out), and the session's registered instruction in unit D-M-3 (keep the original split membership fixed; correcting text and rehashing it would answer a different question).

falsification_tests: A recomputed partition differing from freeze v2 section 2's counts in any cell; an execution step that assigns a text to a side by any rule other than the frozen rule applied to the frozen (uncorrected) text; a corrected text whose hash is recomputed for split purposes.

claims.text: No pooling, and no score-driven correction: the xolkte-family forms (xolkete, pxolkete, xolkte) are checked and reported as distinct forms; no variant is pooled into another form's count and no spelling variant is counted toward a candidate form; a correction enters the adjudication only where the witness comparison demonstrates a discrepancy, and every correction is filed with its witness evidence. This does not establish: that the family's forms are unrelated; only that this diagnostic does not let their relationship move a count.

evidence.description: Unit D-M-3's registered rules (do not pool xolkte-family variants to rescue a failed candidate; correct no uncertain character by its effect on the desired score) and freeze v2 section 7's varietas discipline (spelling variants are data, kept as distinct forms in every count).

falsification_tests: Any pooled xolkte-family count anywhere in the outcome record; any correction in the outcome record without a filed witness divergence behind it; any token counted toward a candidate form on the ground that it is a spelling variant of it.

claims.text: The diagnostic moves no standing by itself: whatever the check finds, Spec 097's frozen Stage 4.4 outcome (1 PARTIALLY SUPPORTED, 5 UNSUPPORTED on held-out), its verdicts, and its tallies stand unchanged on their own records; a demonstrated boundary-crossing discrepancy licenses only a separately registered corrected-input sensitivity result, and a CLAIM STANDS outcome licenses only the interpretation statement of spec section 5.
